steps.content: The squad advances along the route of the attacked FAC Ash Outpost, destroying several more Aurum Secretum devices along the way. As they do, the sandstorm visibly begins to shift direction, retreating from FAC's defensive line and reverting to its previously predictable trajectory.

Perhaps that acting commander was right. This Tide of Ashes is no ordinary calamity—it's a weapon, engineered by the farland enemy. To neutralize it, they have to find and destroy the Aurum Secretum devices that can "resonate with the Apostles."
Suddenly, the squad's most perceptive soldier catches a hint of movement within the swirling sand. He stops dead, raising his binoculars to get a better look.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: There they are! So when do we get to wipe 'em out? What's the holdup? Wire Girl picked up anything yet? Our new commander still off taking a nap?

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Man, don't tell me the commander kicked the bucket screaming orders yesterday. If he doesn't get his act together, there's not gonna be a forward FAC outpost left to save!
steps.female_content: Man, don't tell me the commander kicked the bucket screaming orders yesterday. If she doesn't get her act together, there's not gonna be a forward FAC outpost left to save!

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Ah, who am I kidding? Let 'em drop! More corpses just mean more juice for my cannon. Makes shredding those Outland mutts even sweeter!

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: You're getting a bit loud there, Scar.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Ooh, are we having a lesson? Right before a fight? I love it—Ouch!
The doctor kicks his weapon away and sedates him with a shot to the hip, finally quieting him down.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: The Mania field is volatile. The landscape has shifted and our way forward is blocked. Our original position is no longer tenable.

steps.speaker: Lieutenant
steps.content: Chief, you have more intel than we do. What's your read on the situation?
